changelog: Aura AI v2.3.9 — Smooth Typewriter Voice, Mute Lifecycles, Voice Drawer Category & Draggable Jarvis Bot
Typewriter Full-Line Subtitles: Assistant spoken responses reveal character-by-character as a smooth readable line above the orb
Silent Background Execution & Capability Protection: AI explains capabilities naturally without bragging about new chats, and never accidentally triggers tasks without explicit command
Voice Category in Drawer: New 'Voice' filter chip in navigation drawer displays all ongoing and past voice conversations
Voice Chat Navigation Tools: Open active voice chat ('hamari chat kholo') or previous voice chat ('pichhli chat kholo') directly on screen
5 Clear Voice States & Mute Control: Connecting, Listening, Working, Speaking, Muted. Single tap toggles Mute/Unmute while keeping session alive; Double tap stops session
Draggable Mini Jarvis Bot: The floating robot badge above the composer can now be freely dragged anywhere on screen
